10 September — The ECB raised the three key rates 25bp, taking the deposit rate to 2.50% effective 16 September, with futures pricing a third hike by December.
11 September — US August core CPI rose 0.3% m/m against a 0.2% median, all-items 3.4% y/y, lifting Fed hike odds further.
3-6 September — RBA September hike pricing moved from 17% pre-CPI to roughly 80%, with NAB, Deutsche Bank, UBS and Morgan Stanley all forecasting a move to 4.60%.
2 September — The RBNZ delivered 2.75% with a near-flat track; NZD fell to US58.42c and the two-year swap dropped 8bp.
1 September — 30-year gilts hit 5.697%, the highest since May 1998, but sterling stabilised near $1.354 by 8 September rather than extending losses.
